name: Groove
quote: Melody is an extension of yourself, music notes are symbols of freedom.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Oh... It's you. You're always up so early.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Always follow your heart.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: ... The evening performance is about to begin.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: There's always this strange smell wafting from under the stage when I'm performing, something like pheromones. It's seriously gross.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: DJs are a vital part of nightclubs and bands.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Feel the purple groove before my music stops!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Oh, you've fallen asleep... Welp, guess it's not a big deal.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: There's going to be a small performance tonight, but we seem to be short-staffed. Can you help me out?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hmm?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: What can I do for you?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Huh? What? I can't hear you.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Guess I'll just do it since I can't say no.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Are you the Professor? I think I may have met you somewhere. My name's Groove. I'm a DJ working in a nightclub.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Memorize the melodies by heart.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: My soul, my music, and the machine are all coming together.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Music's true beauty is revealed when a performer is one with the melody.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: I was born ready.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Groove, on stage!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Let's Rock & Roll!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Hehe, a perfect victory!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: What do you say?

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Everything's messed up now...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Huh? I don't know why you'd choose me, but if that's what you want...
Then I suppose I'll accept.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Fewer people frequent the nightclubs the closer it gets to New Year's Day, so the turnout hasn't been so great for my performances lately. Best to go somewhere else for a good vacation, or do you want to hang out a bit with me?

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: It's a shame to waste such a wonderful day here with me when you could be enjoying it with a cute girl instead. Ehehe... Oh well, I'll give you a bar of chocolate to make it up to you. It tastes nice and should make for a good dessert when you're hungry.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: An outdoor live performance is much more spectacular than fireworks. I will make the psychedelic melodies echo through the night sky!

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Punk metal is more than just plastering chrome-plated skulls on your instruments and dressing up in leather and metal accessories. True punk metal performances are all about creating an intense visual impact with some truly soul-shaking music, and Halloween is a great time for that... Hmm, how about chrome-plated pumpkins?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Have you ever seen a punk version of Santa Claus? Wearing a bright red leather jacket and circling the horizon in a sleigh pulled by Cerberus... Hey, don't look at me like that.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Records are nothing too expensive. In this age of digital music, they are pretty much ancient relics now. But I think they're a perfectly acceptable birthday present. So here you go.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
People who hate Techno-pop just don't get it. Its entire appeal is wasted on them.
Despite what they may think, techno music is not just "for kids". It takes a lot of time to really master the necessary skills.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
What is it? Are you asking about this?
DJ tables nowadays are fully touch-controlled. Pretty much anybody can get the hang of it, even without any training beforehand.
I, of course, much prefer the plastic switches, buttons and dials.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
If Techno music is too loud for you, I'll turn the volume down a bit.
Actually, you're not the only one who finds it loud...

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
I had received offers from quite a few different record companies and agencies, but I turned them all down and disappeared from the public eye.
I can't stand the idea of having to work for someone.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
I just want to live a free life where I can do as I please.
Hiding from those record companies and agencies, I eventually followed that person here... I came here by myself, to be exact.
Not exactly a page-turner of a backstory, right? Well, most real-world stories aren't terribly dramatic, after all.

career:
MDJs, Cyber Media's musical Dolls, are mainly targeted at music clubs, radio stations, and streaming channel fans. Their hardware configurations and related services are comparable to top-tier offerings in other sectors.

MDJs have great system performance as well as exceptional learning skills, allowing them to adapt and create freely. They are the main creative force in some second-rate clubs and music radio stations.

Groove is Cyber Media's only MDJ Doll exclusively designed for promotional purposes and is thus not bound by any contract. Groove learned about Project Neural Cloud through a good friend and decided to participate in 42Lab's public test.
infoStories:
Unapproachable, eccentric... These are some of the most common tags associated with Groove on major media sites. However, her friends give an opposing assessment. Groove, in their opinion, is actually quite simple. She pays remarkable attention to those she likes. When it comes to people she despises, she simply ignores them, not even acknowledging them with a nod.

Groove is adamant in her refusal to be swayed by anyone or anything. Because of the freedom provided by Cyber Media, she is able to appreciate her individuality. Many people adore her for it, while others are less enamored. Groove, on the other hand, is unconcerned and refuses to change, and she's more determined than ever to stick to her guns, especially after meeting someone who shares her beliefs.

Nothing enrages an artist, especially a music artist, more than plagiarism and data manipulation.

At the 2055 Navier Online Music Festival, the festival charts were topped by a mashup created by LivingSnake6 (aka Amazonian E-Snake) from Brazil, largely due to data manipulation by bots. Groove was enraged, especially after learning that her friend's debut single had also been mashed into that tune.

Groove worked for three days and three nights to create a new single that was similar to but considerably superior to LivingSnake6's hit, and posted it under the alias HeartBeat. Her single snatched the top spot on the festival charts in less than a week.

Her success was aided by a large number of like-minded peers. However, her abilities in that single are undeniable. And this single also made her alias a household name.

Several MDJ Dolls, such as Groove, have made their name in the business thanks to their skills, but they are not appreciated by all.

"Humph! Cyber Media's branding is irrelevant. They're basically a collection of samples mixed by a program. A data-driven mix of notes isn't even close to being music! At the end of the day, the art is all about your soul, rather than your skills!"
—An excerpt from "To the North" Hip-hop Awards Producer and famous rapper CocoHot's August 12 interview.

Usually, Groove is oblivious to outside criticism and is totally focused on her own music. Hearing such criticism from a teacher she admires, though, still hit her hard.

Journalists approached Cyber Media and requested Groove's comments, which she flatly refused. The mainstream media had two reactions to this: the first was that Groove had succumbed to traditional music, and the second was that Groove was too proud to respond. Only those who know her well can get a peek of her true feelings elsewhere.

Bioelectricity is basically the same as 0s and 1s. Programs evolve as well.
—HeartBeat’s Profile updated on August 15

MDJs, like human artists, can experience writer's block. Groove's approach of finding inspiration is not unique, but quite unusual.

Whenever her inspiration runs out, Groove would put on a pair of oversized black-rimmed glasses and tacky clothing, order a beverage in a jazz bar, and then dance alone on a high-rise rooftop.

On one of her rooftop expeditions, Groove was caught by a security guard who just so happened to be her fan. The guard implored her for an autograph. But Groove had another proposition—he must chase her like how a security guard would chase a real thief. If he could catch her, the autograph was his to keep.

Groove didn't go into detail about what transpired later. However, later that month, Cyber Media released a new MDJ song titled Chase, which quickly rose to the top of the charts.

Artists are a lonesome bunch, and Groove is no exception. There's a whole world within her head that no one else has access to.

Groove enjoys mixing lyrics and musical notes into her daily life. Even if people give her weird looks, she doesn't seem to notice. She would walk into the bustling streets, and rap to every passer-by whenever she's in the mood.

But loneliness is not constant. Groove finally met someone in sync with her.

"The freedom drops deep as does my night."
"I never fill, 'cause to fill is the friend of light."
"Beyond the walls of noodles, life is defined."
"I think of life when I'm in a universal state of mind."
"Wow, you understand what I am singing about?"
"Does it matter? Not at all!"
—Item Mistakenly Swallowed by the Oasis Cleaner Robot. Category: Paper. Returned to: Groove.
oathDesc: Every note dances in my heart, and every beat is a continuation of life.

skinList.name: Sonic Flurry
skinList.desc:
From the "Seaside Concerto" series — an exquisite intersection of fashion and the human body's dynamics. 
She is the violet note that shines brightest on the stage. Though this style is dramatically different from her usual, it hasn't diminished her presnce in the least.
"On this night of fireworks where devils run wild, I'll perform a number for you — A piece of Samurai Rock, done my way!"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Hm? Haha, do you think this gift is too slapdash? The REAL surprise is yet to come."
